_note: C-21 planner parameters. DATA, not code. Separate from scoring-config.json so the planner can be tuned without re-versioning every scorecard. REC values; not Michael-confirmed.

max_candidates.note: top candidates by rank_score considered for subset search (2^n subsets)

probability_resolution.note: probabilities of closing the gap that differ by less than this are treated as equal, then the plan that risks less cash wins

include_maybe.note: MAYBE scorecards may be legs; they are flagged in replace_if_stale and cap confidence at low
